files.scene: Penguin kneels beside a large toy train on a broad oval track encircling a small Christmas tree; simple clear track
Fox plays a small drum while rabbit shakes two large jingle bells, one big star garland above
Deer and bear decorate a snow-covered outdoor evergreen with three large stars at reachable height
Rabbit in plain pajamas opens a present on Christmas morning near a small tree; one big toy boat revealed
All five friends fox rabbit bear deer penguin stand together in a friendly festive portrait with one simple tree behind and a large wrapped gift in front; five distinct bodies without overlaps
Fox rides a short wooden sled downhill, scarf flowing, clear seated pose and bushy tail, no Christmas objects
Rabbit builds a round two-ball snowman, adding one carrot nose, large bucket on snow beside
Bear fills a simple hanging bird feeder with a scoop, two round birds perch beside, broad snowy branch
Deer walks along a curving snowy woodland path between two simple fir trees, one scarf, no Christmas ornaments
Penguin glides on two ice skates over a small frozen pond, flippers spread, one snowbank with reeds
